description: This file defines an enumeration TransactionEntryType representing types of transaction entries (CREDIT and DEBIT) in the Fineract project. It provides methods for retrieving attributes, checking type, and converting to option data types.

classes.name: TransactionEntryType
classes.description: Enum representing transaction entry types: CREDIT and DEBIT.

methods.name: isCredit
methods.description: Returns true if the transaction type is CREDIT.

methods.name: isDebit
methods.description: Returns true if the transaction type is DEBIT.

methods.name: getReversal
methods.description: Returns the opposite transaction type: CREDIT's reversal is DEBIT, and vice versa.

methods.name: toEnumOptionData
methods.description: Converts the enum instance to an EnumOptionData object for UI or API purposes.

methods.name: toStringEnumOptionData
methods.description: Converts the enum instance to a StringEnumOptionData object for UI or API purposes.
